evidence.citation: Kang (2021), Improving MACD Technical Analysis by Optimizing Parameters and Modifying Trading Rules: Evidence from the Japanese Nikkei 225 Futures Market
evidence.caveat: Parameter tuple was selected from a large external search; therefore only clean post-publication holdout has promotion power.

evidence.citation: Kang (2022), Finding Optimal Parameter Values for the MACD Indicator: Evidence From the Japanese Nikkei 225 Futures Market Using a New Methodology
evidence.sample_description: Nikkei 225 futures evidence through 2021, including pandemic-period analysis
evidence.role: External corroboration only; all dates through 2021 excluded from G1 holdout.

stage_a.rationale: Post-publication holdout after 2022 follow-up; ends before JNU Micro launch.

stage_b.evaluation_rule: Burn first 66 usable exact-JNU daily closes for EMA stabilization; evaluate from the next day through latest available.

data.cloud_output: Per-day non-reconstructive daily close-derived signal sufficient statistics only; raw minute bars remain local.

measurement.daily_price: Historical OSE day-session final 1-minute close of each trading day.
measurement.ema_definition: Recursive EMA with alpha=2/(span+1), initialized at first available daily close/MACD value; promotion sample starts only after frozen warmup/burn-in.
measurement.accuracy: Among nonzero histogram and nonzero next-day return, fraction position sign equals next-day return sign.

bootstrap.method: iid resample trading days with replacement

inference.multiplicity_correction: None; exactly one frozen externally specified parameter tuple.

stage_a_pass_rule: At least 200 usable post-publication Mini payoff days.
stage_b_pass_rule: Stage A PASS mandatory; otherwise exact-JNU Stage B statistical evaluation prohibited.
At least 500 exact-JNU payoff days after 66-day burn-in.
Identical MACD(4,22,3), EMA definitions, signal and zero handling; no retuning.
diagnostics_non_promotional: Traditional MACD(12,26,9) as negative-control context only.
forbidden: Search any other MACD parameter tuple.
Use parameter ranges from the papers to select the best tuple.
Add the paper's modified false-signal filters or one-day holding strategy after outcomes.
Change to zero-crossover or alternative EMA initialization after outcomes.
Use 2020-2021 as holdout evidence because those years were already examined in follow-up research.
Use exact-JNU Stage B to rescue failed Mini Stage A.
Claim tradable alpha before execution/cost/overfit/forward stages.

interpretation.pass: If Stage A and exact-JNU Stage B pass, admit a directional information candidate only; then run downstream cost/execution/overfit/forward validation.
interpretation.fail: Close current family. No MACD re-optimization or parameter rescue.
